title: intake.package-list.v1 — GET /intake/v1/packages?delivery=pending response
description: One page of pending packages in ascending sequence. The first page of a sync run fixes until_sequence; later pages reuse it with after=next_after. limit is capped at 100, so a page never holds more than 100 entries.

next_after.description: Value to pass as `after` for the next page; pagination only, not an ACK.

until_sequence.description: High-water sequence fixed when the sync run started; 0 when none.
